willow-creek-ginger-east-s.note: Polk County application 4839, received August 24, 2026, modifies 20 engines whose permit numbers 3847 to 3866 are already held by Ginger East. GEM lists 40 engines but the December 2024 permits list 96, so the engine count is raised as an update.

willow-creek-ginger-east-s-2.note: Polk County application 4840, received August 24, 2026, modifies 16 engines with permit numbers 3982 to 3997, which are already Ginger East engines. Covered by the Ginger East update.

willow-creek-ginger-east-s-3.note: Polk County application 4841, received August 24, 2026, is for 14 engines of 4,308 horsepower with new permit numbers 4165 to 4178. The application does not say if they are at Willow Creek or Ginger East, so a question is raised on Ginger East. Capacity is not found.

meta-altoona.note: State Title V permit 18-TV-007R1 lists 112 emergency generators, 328.0 MW.

google-council-bluffs.note: State permits for QUESTA LLC list about 720 diesel engines in horsepower only, so capacity is blank. A second Google site, TETRA LLC on Veterans Memorial Parkway, had its permits rescinded in March 2026 and is a question.

apple-waukee.note: I searched the Iowa DNR construction permit directory (all 3,283 facilities) for Apple, Waukee, data and the Hickman Road address, with no Apple or Apple site company found; the only Waukee facilities are unrelated businesses. I read all 315 rows of the EasyAir active applications list and searched it by Apple Inc, Apple, Waukee, Hickman and data center, with no Apple application. Dallas County has no local air program (only Polk and Linn do). Web searches for Apple at 2995 W Hickman Road, Waukee found no generator count or air permit, and city council records turned up nothing. Not found: any generator fleet for this site.

qts-fairfax.note: Linn County permits issued October 1, 2025 list 74 and 14 engines, 88 in all. That agrees with GEM.

microsoft-west-des-moines.note: The permits issued October 20, 2026 cover 130 large engines and 6 small ones. GEM has 120 large engines, so the count and capacity are raised.

microsoft-west-des-moines-2.note: Title V permit 24-TV-004 agrees with GEM's 100 large engines and 300 MW. Four smaller engines are raised as a question.

microsoft-west-des-moines-3.note: The brief matched this to Ginger East, but the permit record at 8855 Grand Avenue (Microsoft DM1-4) is a different site, not in GEM. Willow Creek, at 550 SE White Crane Road, is also not in GEM and is added as a plant.

edged-council-bluffs.note: The lead names no generators, and a web search found none.

sailfish-digital-venture-council-bluffs.note: The lead names no generators. A web search found Sailfish's gas plans only in Texas and nothing for Council Bluffs.

us-ia:new:microsoft-willow-creek-data-ce.evidence: GEM's Microsoft Ginger East record is 0.8 kilometers away and its note cites the same Title V permit, 24-TV-005. That permit covers two sites. Its record keeping lists the Willow Creek engines as units 1 to 86 at 550 SE White Crane Road and the Ginger East engines as units 101 to 201 at 1475 SE Maffitt Lake Road. This record holds only units 1 to 86, so it does not repeat any engine already in Ginger East. Meta Altoona, the other plant in Polk County, belongs to another company at another site.

us-ia:new:microsoft-west-des-moines-gran.evidence: The nearest GEM plants are Microsoft's Ginger West, 3.0 kilometers away under permit 26-TV-003 in Dallas County, Osmium, 5.6 kilometers away under permit 24-TV-004 in Warren County, and Ginger East, 9.3 kilometers away under permit 24-TV-005. This site is facility 25-17-007 at 8855 Grand Avenue, with its own permits from 2010 to 2022. The address and permits differ from all three.

us-ia:new:meta-altoona-data-center-power.evidence: The only overlap is that Microsoft's Willow Creek site, also in this batch, is in the same county. It is another company's site several kilometers away. No GEM plant shares this name or sits near this point.

us-ia:new:google-council-bluffs-bunge-av.evidence: The nearby GEM plant is the Walter Scott Jr. coal plant, 4.0 kilometers away, owned by MidAmerican Energy. It is a utility coal plant. This record is a backup engine fleet at a Google data center, so they are different plants. The name match is only the city name Council Bluffs.
